08The rules

On 6 October, the rules changed.

We plan inside them from day one. Your legal team signs the final checklist.

RuleWhat it means on social
NMC public notice, 6 October 2026No testimonials or patient success stories, no “best” or guaranteed outcomes, no AI-made patients, no pay linked to referrals.
ASCIIVF success-rate and “best” claims have been upheld as misleading. Creators giving health advice state their qualifications.
ART Act, Surrogacy Act, PCPNDT ActNothing that suggests sex selection or commercial surrogacy, on any channel.
Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, 1954Its schedule lists sterility in women, so no line reads as a cure or remedy claim.
DPDP Act and Meta ad policyExplicit consent before patient data touches marketing. Ads never imply a viewer’s health.
Sources: NMC notice as reported by The South First and BestMediaInfo; ASCI; India Code; Meta. Full list on the last page.Page08/31

25The code

Eight rules we sign in week one.

Every brief, post and reply is checked against them. Your teams edit and sign them first.

Rule01

Every claim is checked

Medical lines come from a named specialist and pass review.

Rule02

Hope, told honestly

No guarantees, no success-rate headlines, no “best”.

Rule03

Both partners, always

We name factors and never blame a partner.

Rule04

Every path counts

For people trying, freezing eggs, or still deciding.

Rule05

Testimonials stay out

No patient success stories, per the October 2026 NMC notice.

Rule06

Hard days, planned for

Mother’s Day and festive “good news” get a quieter calendar.

Rule07

Real, calm imagery

Real rooms and warm light. No AI-made patients.

Rule08

Words that comfort

We retire “failed” and “barren”, and write like a counsellor talks.

A draft for your medical, legal and counselling teams to edit and sign.Page25/31

26The care

Every comment is a person on a hard day.

01Human reply

1 hr

Every DM, 9 a.m. to 10 p.m., seven days a week.

01

Within 1 hour

Every DM gets a human reply, 9 a.m. to 10 p.m., seven days.

02

Within 2 hours

Every comment is answered, or hidden and logged when it shames or misleads.

03

Within 15 minutes

Any sign of crisis goes to a trained counsellor, with Tele-MANAS, 14416, in the reply.

04

Always

No diagnosis in a DM. Medical questions move to Fertility Circle, 1800 123 1515, with consent.

05

Every week

A listening report: new questions, themes, sentiment and risks.

Service levels are Mask360’s proposal. Our care team trains with your counsellors before launch.Page26/31

31Appendix

Every number, and where it came from.

01Social today

Public profiles, October 2026, approximate: @birlafertility about 35K Instagram followers; @birlafertility_armcivf about 11K; Facebook about 12K; YouTube @birlafertilityivf 470+ videos and about 10M views; X @BirlaIvf; @indiraivfgroup about 391K. 50+ centres and 120+ experts: @birlafertility on Instagram.

02The numbers

Over 90% of people facing fertility problems feel emotionally exhausted and 29% seek timely help: Birla Fertility & IVF study, released with Fertility Circle, June 2025 (MediaBrief). Male factors in 40 to 50% of cases in India: Indian Society of Assisted Reproduction, via BioSpectrum India.

03Birla Fertility & IVF

ARMC IVF, May 2024, and BabyScience, August 2024 (Venture Intelligence, BioSpectrum India). “All Heart. All Science.” (Digital Health News). Fertility Circle, 1800 123 1515, in English and Hindi (MediaBrief, June 2025).

04The category

Indira IVF: 165+ centres (Business Standard, July 2025), Tumko Meri Kasam (ThePrint, 2025). Nova IVF Fertility creator series (Confluencr). Cloudnine Fertility, “Every Fertility Journey is Different”, World IVF Day 2026 (Business News This Week). Ferty9 #TogetherInIVF (MediaNews4U). Motherhood “I Am Very Fortunate” (Motherhood India).

05The rules

NMC public notice of 6 October 2026, as reported by The South First and BestMediaInfo. ASCI Consumer Complaints Council releases, October 2019 and January 2020; ASCI guidelines for health and finance influencers, 2023. ART (Regulation) Act 2021, section 32; Surrogacy (Regulation) Act 2021, section 38; PCPNDT Act, section 22; Drugs and Magic Remedies Act 1954, schedule (India Code). DPDP Rules, November 2025. Meta advertising standards.

06Care

Tele-MANAS, India’s national mental health helpline: 14416. Fertility Circle, Birla Fertility & IVF’s counselling line: 1800 123 1515.

07Mask360

Clients, managed feeds and the Nexa Platinum Lounge result come from Mask360’s own records. Pillars, series, formats, cadence, sample posts, captions, service levels and dates are Mask360’s proposal.
